# Projects surface: map

**Owns:** the Projects page (a card each with its onboarding badge; adding one by asking Devops to onboard it, `AskDevopsButton`, or by path) and a Project's page: its onboarding (`onboarding-block.tsx`, from Work's `GET /onboardings`, joined by Project and refreshed by any Task event since it sits under the Tasks' query key), commands, install inputs, publishing mode, default Pipeline, the environment check, the Project's skills. It reads the service through `src/api/` (see [the web app's map](../../MAP.md)).
